methods.name: DSDM
methods.description: Module that generates attention maps demonstrating distinct semantic responses

methods.name: DITP
methods.description: Component featuring a denoising path to enhance the generality of the framework

methods.name: DCI-VTON
methods.description: Baseline virtual try-on method evaluated for warped results comparison

methods.name: GP-VTON
methods.description: Baseline virtual try-on method that mitigates texture squeezing using dynamic gradient truncation

methods.name: PBE
methods.description: Exemplar-based image inpainting architecture whose architecture and pretrained parameters are adopted by the synthesis network.

methods.name: Differential Information Tracking Path (DITP)
methods.description: A path introduced to replace a simplistic inpainting path to address conflicts and learning ambiguities when simultaneously managing denoising and inpainting tasks.

methods.name: Dynamic Semantics Selector
methods.description: Dynamically selects feature channels that capture similar semantics using the self-similarity of garment features to unsupervisedly generate selection masks indicating each channel's semantic group.

methods.name: Group Warping Block
methods.description: Responsible for generating flows and attention maps for different channel groups.

methods.name: Disentangled Warping Operation
methods.description: Uses the selection mask and predicted flows and attention maps to deform garment features.

methods.name: Gumbel-Softmax
methods.description: A differentiable method ensuring exclusive assignment to determine the semantic group for each channel based on responses in the self-similarity matrix.

methods.name: fixed grouping
methods.description: An ablation setting where all channels are evenly divided sequentially without using the Dynamic Semantics Selector

methods.name: Vanilla
methods.description: A baseline setting used to train the deformation network without semantics grouping or DSDM
